title: Cold rebuild: Pipeline exit status
summary: Rebuild Pipeline exit status from memory, no hints.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Pipeline exit status** in *Conditions, loops, functions and strict mode*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.prompt: With **only** `set -e` (no pipefail), the script runs `curl -fsS http://bad.host/data | jq .count > count.txt`. curl fails (exit 6), jq succeeds on empty input. What happens?
options: The script continues: the pipeline's status is jq's (0)
bash refuses to run the pipeline
steps.explain: Without pipefail only the last command counts. With `-o pipefail` the pipeline returns 6 and `-e` stops the script.
